title.zh: Trump accord calls for tech firms to ‘self police’ their own frontier AI
title.en: Trump accord calls for tech firms to ‘self police’ their own frontier AI

current_state.zh: US President Donald Trump and tech executives signed a voluntary White House accord, the 'Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities,' under which frontier AI developers commit to internal controls, independent external audits, and board-level oversight of their models while leaving open a future shift to formal regulation.
current_state.en: US President Donald Trump and tech executives signed a voluntary White House accord, the 'Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities,' under which frontier AI developers commit to internal controls, independent external audits, and board-level oversight of their models while leaving open a future shift to formal regulation.
